data.title: Jordan Condemns Houthi Terrorist Militia Attacks on Riyadh
data.content:
Amman, November 19, 2026, SPA -- The Jordanian government today condemned the attacks carried out by the Houthi terrorist militia on Riyadh, which caused material damage to the King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD). It described the attacks as a flagrant violation of international law and the United Nations Charter, an unacceptable infringement of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty, and a threat to its security, stability, and the safety of its citizens.
    In a statement, the Jordanian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Expatriates affirmed Jordan's categorical rejection and condemnation of the continued blatant attacks on civilians and civilian and economic facilities in Saudi Arabia.
    The ministry also reaffirmed Jordan's full solidarity with Saudi Arabia and its unwavering support for all measures Saudi Arabia has taken to protect its security, sovereignty, stability, national assets, and the safety of its citizens and residents.
    
    -- SPA
